title: Co-culture of primary human T cells with leukemia cells to measure regulatory T cell expansion
protocol: Aliquot 8–15 mL of peripheral blood into 50 mL tubes.
Dilute peripheral blood with PBS/0.5% BSA to a volume of 35 mL.
Prepare one 50 mL tube with 10 mL Lymphocyte Separation Media for each PB tube.
Carefully overlay the separation media with the diluted PB while maintaining clear phase separation.
Centrifuge at 20°C for 30 min at 400 × g without brake to enable separation of PBMC.
Pipette the plasma into another 50 mL tube without disturbing the white PBMC layer.
Use a 1,000 μL pipette to transfer the PBMC into a separate 50 mL tube.
Discard the remaining layers.
Add PBS/0.5% BSA until reaching a volume of 50 mL for washing the PBMC.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min with brake.
Sterile filter plasma using a 50 mL syringe capped with a 0.20 μm sterile filter during centrifugation.
Store filtered plasma below -20°C.
Heat inactivate plasma at 56°C for 30 min in a preheated water bath (optional).
Perform an RBC lysis step if the PBMC pellet is red.
Discard supernatant and resuspend pellet in RBC lysis buffer.
Incubate at 20°C for 10 min.
Add 30 mL PBS/BSA 0.5% after incubation.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min with brake.
Discard supernatant and resuspend pellet in 7 mL PBS/BSA 0.5%.
Count the total number of PBMC.
Use CD4 and CD8 MicroBeads human to magnetically separate CD4+ and CD8+ T cells according to the manufacturer’s protocol.
Ensure at least 66% of total PBMC suspension is used for CD8+ enrichment.
Activate T cells using the T Cell Activation/Expansion Kit human according to the manufacturer’s protocol.
Use a bead-to-cell ratio of 1:2.
Cultivate activated T cells in T cell media for 16 hours at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Perform flow cytometry with 1 × 10^6 CD4+ and 1 × 10^6 CD8+ non-activated T cells to check purity of MACS enrichment.
Seed 2 × 10^6 SEM::mock and 2 × 10^6 SEM::EGR3 cells in 2 mL T cell media in a 6-well plate.
Add 2 μL of a 1 μg/μL Doxycycline working solution to reach a final concentration of 1 μg/mL in the media.
Cultivate cells 16 h at 37°C and 5% CO2 and saturated humidity.
Count SEM::mock and SEM::EGR3 cells.
Seed two wells of a 24-well plate with 1 × 10^6 cells of each cell line in 880 μL T cell media supplemented with 1 μg Doxycycline.
Treat each cell line with 40 μL of a 0.5 μg/μL working solution of neutralizing α-ICOSLG antibody or IgG1 isotype control to reach a final concentration of 20 μg/mL.
Cultivate the treated cells for 2 h at 37°C and 5% CO2 with saturated humidity.
Count the number of activated CD4+ and CD8+ T cells and adjust to 1,25 × 10^7 T cells/mL.
Add 40 μL CD4+ (=5 × 10^5 cells) and 40 μL CD8+ (=5 × 10^5 cells) T cells to each well with SEM cells.
Carefully mix by pipetting up and down.
Cultivate the co-culture for 48 h at 37°C and 5% CO2 with saturated humidity.
Transfer the whole cell suspension to a tube after 48 hours of co-culture.
Centrifuge the cells at 300 × g for 10 minutes.
Transfer each supernatant into another tube and store at -80°C.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 100 μL PBS/0.5% BSA.
Add 5 μL of Human BD Fc Block to the resuspended cells.
Incubate the cells with BD Fc Block for at least 10 minutes at 20°C.
Prepare two antibody master mixes with 5 μL of each antibody in 50 μL Brilliant Stain Buffer.
Mix the antibody master mixes thoroughly.
Dispense the prepared antibody master mixes among FACS tubes according to Table 1.
Add 50 μL of blocked cell suspension to each FACS tube containing the antibody mix.
Incubate the mixture for 30 min at 20°C, protected from light.
Wash by adding 2 mL PBS/0.5% BSA to each tube.
Centrifuge the tubes at 400 × g at 20°C for 5 min.
Discard the supernatant carefully.
Wash cells by adding 2 mL PBS/0.5% BSA.
Centrifuge at 400 × g at 20°C for 5 min and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 100 μL 1× Annexin Binding Buffer.
Add 5 μL Annexin V Pacific Blue.
Incubate 15 min at 20°C protected from light.
Wash cells by adding 2 mL PBS/0.5% BSA.
Centrifuge at 600 × g at 20°C for 6 min and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend in 300 μL 1× Annexin Binding Buffer.
Add 3 μL 7-AAD.
Incubate 5–15 min on ice.
Vortex pellet from step 27.
Resuspend in 1 mL Fix/Perm and vortex again.
Incubate 40–50 min at 2°C–8°C protected from light.
Add 1 mL Perm/Wash to wash the sample.
Centrifuge at 600 × g for 6 min at 4°C.
Discard supernatant.
Wash through addition of 2 mL Perm/Wash.
Centrifuge at 600 × g for 6 min at 4°C.
Discard supernatant.
Resuspend in 80 μL Perm/Wash.
Add 5 μL of FOXP3 antibody to all batches except the FOXP3 negative control batch prepared at step 25.
Incubate at 2°C–8°C for 40–50 min protected from light.
Vortex and wash through addition of 2 mL Perm/Wash.
Centrifuge at 600 × g for 6 min at 4°C.
Discard supernatant.
Wash through addition of 2 mL Perm/Wash.
Centrifuge at 600 × g for 6 min at 4°C.
Discard supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 350 μL PBS/0.5% BSA.
Perform flow cytometry with gating as explained in the relevant figure.
Calculate the percentage of the CD4+CD25+FOXP3+ population among the CD4+ population.
Perform cytokine quantification using ELISAs on frozen co-culture supernatants.
Measure IL-10 secretion by Tregs in the supernatant samples.
Assess general T cell activation by measuring IL-2 levels in the supernatant samples.
